name: Volumetric Parity Test
definition: A test that classifies a 3D point P as inside (1) or outside (0) of a solid specified by a VDS. It transforms the point into LDI texture space and marches a ray through depth layers, swapping parity when crossing a layer.
summary: The Volumetric Parity Test is a real-time algorithm that classifies 3D points as inside or outside a volume using a parity-swap ray march through layered depth layers, enabling pixel-precise clipping in a single pass.
